verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents an official MCP server on its first-party developer docs. The docs say it works with any MCP-capable AI tool (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Windsurf) and exposes CRM operations such as COQL queries and bulk record operations through natural language. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection and setup/auth details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Zoho CRM MCP servers work with any AI tool that supports MCP, including Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Windsurf.
This allows you to perform CRM operations directly from your AI tool using natural language, without navigating the CRM interface or working with APIs.
Query records across standard and custom modules using COQL
